services.desc: Core Burn Pilates partners with Core Pilates LLC to host bespoke Teacher Training program. The program was meticulously designed by expert Pilates instructors, including Core Burn Pilates’ Founder, Tamara Slupchynskyj - who trained with a renowned Pilates elder, Lolita San Miguel - and Master Instructors Lorena Egan Alvarado and Larysa Shelton The Teacher Training is led by a team of industry-leading experts and is designed to equip you with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to teach Pilates to clients of all levels.
